name: Pokédex
description: Search a loaded Pokémon list and inspect PokéAPI details.

limit.label: Loaded Pokémon
limit.description: Number of names loaded for local search.

template:
<Stack gap='sm'>
  <Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' align='center'>
    <Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <Text fz={20} fw={700}>Pokédex</Text>
      <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>PokéAPI · browse names, then open a Pokémon</Text>
    </Stack>
    <RefreshButton requestId='pokemon' label='Refresh Pokémon' />
  </Group>
  <SimpleGrid minColWidth={240} autoFlow='auto-fit' spacing='md'>
    <Stack gap='xs' style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <TextInput bind='filter' defaultValue='' label='Search loaded names' placeholder='Filter this page' />
      <Select bind='selected' defaultValue='' label='Choose from loaded names' placeholder='Search Pokémon' searchable clearable data={(data.pokemon?.results ?? []).map(item => ({ value: item.name, label: item.name }))} />
      {status.pokemon?.loading ? <Skeleton height={160} /> : status.pokemon?.ok === false ? <Alert color='red' title='Pokémon list unavailable'>{status.pokemon.statusText || status.pokemon.error || 'Request failed'}</Alert> : (data.pokemon?.results ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No Pokémon names were returned.</Text> : <Stack gap='xs'>
        <Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' align='baseline'>
          <Text size='sm' fw={600}>Loaded names</Text>
          <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>{(data.pokemon.results ?? []).filter(item => item.name.includes((inputs.filter ?? '').trim().toLowerCase())).length} shown · {data.pokemon.count ?? '—'} total</Text>
        </Group>
        {(data.pokemon.results ?? []).filter(item => item.name.includes((inputs.filter ?? '').trim().toLowerCase())).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No matches on this loaded page.</Text> : <SimpleGrid minColWidth={110} autoFlow='auto-fit' spacing='xs'>{(data.pokemon.results ?? []).filter(item => item.name.includes((inputs.filter ?? '').trim().toLowerCase())).map(item => <Text key={item.name} size='sm' truncate>{item.name}</Text>)}</SimpleGrid>}
      </Stack>}
      <TextInput bind='lookup' defaultValue='' label='Direct name lookup' placeholder='e.g. pikachu' />
      <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>A direct name takes priority over the selected loaded name.</Text>
    </Stack>
    <Stack gap='xs' style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <Text size='sm' fw={600}>Pokémon details</Text>
      {(inputs.lookup ?? '').trim().length === 0 && (inputs.selected ?? '').trim().length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>Choose a loaded name or enter a direct lookup to begin.</Text> : <SubFetch requestId='detail' trigger='manual' params={{ name: (inputs.lookup ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() || (inputs.selected ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() }} triggerContent={<Text size='sm' fw={600}>Open {(inputs.lookup ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() || (inputs.selected ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()}</Text>} triggerAriaLabel='Load Pokémon details'>
        {(pokemon) => pokemon?.name ? <Stack gap='sm'>
          <Group align='center' wrap='nowrap' gap='sm'>
            {pokemon.sprites?.other?.['official-artwork']?.front_default || pokemon.sprites?.front_default ? <Image src={pokemon.sprites?.other?.['official-artwork']?.front_default ?? pokemon.sprites?.front_default} alt={pokemon.name} h={144} fit='contain' /> : <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>Artwork unavailable</Text>}
            {pokemon.sprites?.front_default && pokemon.sprites?.other?.['official-artwork']?.front_default ? <Stack gap={2} align='center'><Image src={pokemon.sprites.front_default} alt={`${pokemon.name} game sprite`} h={64} fit='contain' /><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Game sprite</Text></Stack> : null}
            <Stack gap={4} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Text fz={24} fw={700} truncate>{pokemon.name}</Text>
              <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>#{pokemon.id}</Text>
              <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Types</Text>
              <Group gap='xs'>{(pokemon.types ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>—</Text> : (pokemon.types ?? []).map(item => <Badge key={item.slot} color={({ grass: 'green', fire: 'orange', water: 'blue', electric: 'lime', psychic: 'violet', ice: 'cyan', dragon: 'indigo', dark: 'dark', fairy: 'pink', normal: 'gray', fighting: 'red', poison: 'grape', ground: 'orange', flying: 'blue', bug: 'lime', rock: 'gray', ghost: 'violet', steel: 'gray' })[item.type.name] ?? 'gray'}>{item.type.name}</Badge>)}</Group>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
          <SimpleGrid minColWidth={100} autoFlow='auto-fit' spacing='xs'>
            <Stack gap={2}><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Height</Text><Text size='sm' fw={600}>{pokemon.height == null ? '—' : `${(pokemon.height / 10).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} m`}</Text></Stack>
            <Stack gap={2}><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Weight</Text><Text size='sm' fw={600}>{pokemon.weight == null ? '—' : `${(pokemon.weight / 10).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} kg`}</Text></Stack>
          </SimpleGrid>
          <Stack gap='xs'><Text size='sm' fw={600}>Abilities</Text>{(pokemon.abilities ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No abilities listed.</Text> : (pokemon.abilities ?? []).map(item => <Group key={item.ability.name} justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'><Text size='sm' truncate>{item.ability.name}</Text>{item.is_hidden ? <Badge color='gray'>Hidden</Badge> : null}</Group>)}</Stack>
          <Stack gap='xs'><Text size='sm' fw={600}>Base stats</Text>{(pokemon.stats ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No base stats listed.</Text> : (pokemon.stats ?? []).map(item => <Stack key={item.stat.name} gap={2}><Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap'><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>{item.stat.name}</Text><Text size='xs' fw={600}>{item.base_stat}</Text></Group><Progress value={Math.min((item.base_stat / 255) * 100, 100)} size='sm' color='violet' /></Stack>)}</Stack>
        </Stack> : <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No Pokémon details were returned.</Text>}
      </SubFetch>}
    </Stack>
  </SimpleGrid>
</Stack>
